title: RTT Resonance Truth Coherence State
description: Schema for a Coherence State produced by an RTT Resonance Truth Service v0.1 Evaluation. A Coherence State describes the structural compatibility of qualified evidence under the governing Regime. Coherence is not defined as simple value equality, source count, or majority vote.

coherence_state_id.description: Stable identifier for this Coherence State.

evaluation_id.description: Identifier of the Evaluation that produced this Coherence State.

status.description: Structural Coherence classification for the Evaluation.

cluster_ids.description: Identifiers of Coherence clusters associated with this state. Cluster definitions may be serialized separately or embedded in fixture/test structures.

supporting_observation_ids.description: Qualified observations supporting the synthesized or dominant Coherence field.

dissenting_observation_ids.description: Qualified observations that remain materially divergent from the supporting Coherence field. Dissent is preserved rather than silently deleted.

cluster_count.description: Number of structurally meaningful Coherence clusters identified during Evaluation. This is descriptive output and does not itself determine Coherence status.

source_independence.description: Summary classification of the structural independence of Evidence participating in the Coherence result. This field must not substitute for explicit Lineage analysis.

rationale.description: Structured reasons explaining why this Coherence classification was produced.

evaluated_at.description: Timestamp at which this Coherence State was produced, when serialized independently from its parent Evaluation.

metadata.description: Optional domain-specific or implementation metadata. Metadata must not override canonical Coherence fields.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the Coherence decision.

evidence_references.description: Identifiers of observations, sources, clusters, regimes, lineage entities, or other evidence relevant to this reason.

regime_rule.description: Optional governing Regime rule relevant to the decision.

then.description: An indeterminate Coherence State may legitimately contain no supporting or dissenting observations when no sufficiently qualified Evidence remains available.

rationale.message: All qualified observations form one mutually compatible temporal cluster under the declared Regime.
Two independent qualified observations form the dominant coherent cluster while one materially divergent qualified observation remains preserved as dissent.
Two internally coherent and independently supported temporal clusters remain mutually incompatible, and the Evaluation provides no justified basis for selecting either cluster as dominant.
No observations remain sufficiently qualified to form a current Coherence field.
